stem: Sameer watches three changes. Which statements correctly say whether a new substance has formed?

statements.text: An iron nail left in damp air gets a brown flaky coat: a new substance has formed, so this is a chemical change.
Chalk is crushed to powder: no new substance has formed, so this is a physical change.
Ice melts in a glass: a new substance has formed, so this is a chemical change.

teacher.key_rationale: Rusting forms a new substance (chemical). Crushing chalk does not (physical). Melting ice does not form a new substance (physical), so statement 3 is wrong.
